declaration.announced: Record announced Schneider/Schwarz and declared Ouvert, not achieved levels or later exposure.
declaration.confirm_clear: Clear the declarer and declaration explicitly. Existing Plays must still validate.
declaration.correction: Correct the declaration at accepted revision {revision}. The existing continuation is replayed only until its first rejection.
declaration.count_examples: With two: Clubs and Spades Jacks held, Hearts Jack absent. Without two: Clubs and Spades Jacks absent, Hearts Jack held. Both use the positive count 2; the number does not encode with or without.
declaration.count_help: Count consecutive highest trumps held or absent from the top, starting with the Jack of Clubs, not the total Jacks or trumps. Legitimately known Skat ownership is included. Suit: 1–11; Grand: 1–4; Null: no count.
declaration.count_summary: Optional Matador count — leave blank if unknown
declaration.dependencies: Suit/Grand: Hand → Schneider → Schwarz → Ouvert. Each requires all options before it.
declaration.null: Null: independent Hand/Ouvert; no Schneider/Schwarz announcements or Matadors. Clear incompatible input explicitly.
declaration.rejected_input: Unaccepted input from the earlier form
declaration.session_count: A supplied count must be verifiable from this recording's permitted evidence. Live defenders cannot supply a concrete count. Leave an unverified count blank; do not enter unknown opponent Cards. Blank does not promise automatic inference.
declaration.title: Game declaration

guided.advanced.dataset_help: Dataset and evaluation operations are advanced automation workflows and are not configured from this page.
guided.advanced.method_help: Standard immediate analysis is the default. Bounded Search is strict and has no fallback. Auto tries Search first and may use the existing Immediate fallback. Information-set Search is selected-world, fixed-policy, and bounded, not perfect play.
guided.advanced.policy_help: Policies are fixed rule-based behavior assumptions, not AI predictions. Side-specific values keep existing precedence and may change evidence, runtime, and recommendations.
guided.advanced.provenance_help: Provenance reports public-safe field origin and information timing. It is not Confidence, probability, correctness, or authorship, and it can enlarge technical output.
guided.advanced.runtime_help: More samples can increase runtime and simulation precision. Seeds make repeated runs reproducible. Samples are not calibrated probabilities. Search uses the existing interactive budget and timing is not a quality guarantee.
guided.advanced.simulation_help: Steps count new local Decisions. Simulated opponent Cards are not hidden truth. Simulation runs only when selected and preserves the existing nine phases, fallback, ordering, and information boundaries.
guided.choice: What would you like to do?
guided.hidden_help: Do not enter hidden opponent hands. The server checks every known Card for duplicates.
guided.import_help: Import one strict SkatMind JSON object. Import validates but does not run it.
guided.imported_executed: This imported Request produced the Result shown above.
guided.imported_retained: The document is validated and retained in memory.
guided.matadors_help: Leave Matadors empty where existing inference or an unavailable value is permitted. SkatMind calculates Game value.
guided.process_local: Process-local only. Closing SkatMind discards unsaved drafts and Results. Explicit JSON download is the only export.
guided.reset_confirm: Confirm discarding this process-local draft and Result
guided.review.coaching_help: Coaching and Tactical outputs use their existing prerequisites and evidence limits. They do not establish ground truth, intent, causation, or global optimality.
guided.review.deal_help: Assign all 32 Cards exactly: ten per Player and two to the Skat. No Cards are generated or corrected.
guided.review.declaration_help: All four Null variants use the existing Hand and Ouvert dependencies. Product validation remains authoritative.
guided.review.method_help: Optional reviews assess chronological Decisions using existing Immediate or bounded Search methods. Search can increase runtime and has no perfect-play claim.
guided.review.options_help: Game validation, Result, and Settlement are always included. No optional family runs unless selected.
guided.review.output.information_set_sea: Hidden-card uncertainty review required for coaching
guided.review.play_progress: Play {count} of 30. Completed Tricks: {tricks}. Current Trick: {cards}.
guided.review.players_help: Seats are fixed. Display labels are optional and remain process-local.
guided.review.policy_help: Historical reviews retain existing fixed public Policy behavior. This editor adds no learned prediction or separate opponent-data source.
guided.review.runtime_help: Search-dependent reviews use the existing Historical Review budget profile. Samples can increase runtime; seeds preserve reproducibility. Timing is not a quality guarantee.
guided.review.scope_help: The guided editor emits normal completion only. Existing supported shortened endings, continuations, party-wide Claims, and Position post-game variants remain available through strict JSON import.
guided.review.two_discards: Select exactly two Cards discarded after pickup.
guided.rules_help: SkatMind derives each completed-Trick winner and the next Player through existing rules.
guided.run_help: Run validates this exact visible-information Position and executes it once.
guided.sizes_help: Opponent sizes mean Cards remaining. They are derived from attributed public play when possible.
guided.tricks_help: Select completed Tricks in chronological order. Leave unused rows empty.

recorded_review.analyze_unavailable: Current-position analysis is unavailable: it needs your turn and an exact playable hand. Saved recorded decisions remain available separately above.
recorded_review.coverage: {available} of {recorded} recorded own Plays have a usable saved decision snapshot.
recorded_review.diverged: {count} saved snapshots no longer match the accepted history after correction. Check the recorded history; these snapshots cannot review the changed decisions.
recorded_review.ended_without_play: {count} saved snapshots have no actual Card because the Game ended before that Play. The ending remains in the recorded history.
recorded_review.future: {count} saved snapshots are ahead of the current history after Undo. They become eligible only if the accepted recording reaches and reproduces that decision and its Play.
recorded_review.history: Open history, correction, and Reload controls
recorded_review.limit: This compares one recorded decision from the captured perspective using its frozen method and decision-time information. It is bounded analysis, not optimal ground truth, final-outcome causality, or complete three-Player Game review.
recorded_review.missing: {count} recorded own Plays have no usable saved snapshot. The recording is still supported; this view cannot reconstruct missing decision-time evidence from final hands.
recorded_review.no_perspective: This recording has no selected own perspective, so no own-decision review is available here.
recorded_review.no_snapshots: No decision snapshots were saved with this recording. You can keep recording or inspect its history, but this view cannot recover earlier missing snapshots.
recorded_review.pending: {count} saved snapshots are waiting for an observed Play. Record the actual Card through normal Card entry when it is known.
recorded_review.review_unavailable: Full Historical review is unavailable: it needs a completed Retrospective Game with the required original evidence. Recorded-decision review uses the saved own-decision snapshots independently.
recorded_review.title: Review recorded decisions
recordings.empty: No recordings of this type were found. Start with the recording link below.
recordings.introduction: Choose an individual Game or Match. Partial recordings can be opened too; available review depends on the saved decision-time evidence.
recordings.lifetime: Opening another recording of the same type replaces its active context and discards its temporary Results and correction previews. Returning to the same unchanged source keeps them until an edit, reload, or restart.
recordings.manual_help: Manual review is a separate input path. This link continues any existing manual draft or Result.
recordings.match.coverage: Review one recorded decision using its safely reconstructed information. Availability is not a guarantee of successful analysis; method and evidence limits still apply.
recordings.match.historical: Full Historical review needs a complete reconstructable original deal, completed play, and an exact Match timestamp. Individual decisions are prepared separately.
recordings.match.materialization: Explicitly prepare existing Match exports from the recorded evidence. This does not execute analysis and is not required for individual decision review.
recordings.match.prepared: {prepared} of {total} recorded decisions are prepared for individual review.
recordings.reload.sessions: Reload the active individual Game explicitly
recordings.reload_help: Use this after an external file change. Reload replaces in-memory state and discards its temporary Results and previews.
recordings.skip.acting_hand_unavailable: The acting Player's decision-time hand cannot be reconstructed from this evidence.
recordings.skip.required_public_hand_una: The required publicly visible hand is unavailable at this decision.
recordings.storage_help: Inspect local storage information to resolve invalid or duplicate-identity files
recovery.annotations_unchanged: Free-text commentary and response links remain unchanged. Review their wording after correcting a Card.
recovery.candidate_warning: The partial candidate is accepted by the recording contract, but this evidence conflict remains. Applying it does not establish complete repair.
recovery.check_evidence: Check hand, Skat, and discard evidence
recovery.complete_replay: Completing the trace triggered replay of all Plays. The conflict is at the location above, not necessarily at the last Card.
recovery.confirm: I have reviewed this preview and want to apply it
recovery.metadata_unchanged: Game identity, declaration, hand/Skat/discard evidence, and retained Play Players, indexes, and timecodes stay unchanged.
recovery.observations: These observations contradict each other under the recorded declaration. This does not identify which observation was entered incorrectly. Inspect the relevant Trick and evidence before correcting or rewinding.
recovery.reason.discard: This Card conflicts with recorded discards.
recovery.reason.duplicate: This Card occurs twice in the proposed trace. The linked witness is the other occurrence.
recovery.reason.follow_suit: The recorded Card does not follow the required effective suit, although the evidence below shows a matching Card was held.
recovery.reason.ownership: This Card conflicts with the recorded ownership or exact playable hand.
recovery.reason.skat: This Card conflicts with original Skat evidence and the recorded declaration.
recovery.reason.wrong_actor: The retained Player is inconsistent with seat order or the preceding Trick winner. A correction never reassigns Players automatically.
recovery.rejected: Proposed Card input: {cards}. This attempt was not saved; accepted history below is unchanged.
recovery.removal: Keep {retained} Plays and remove {removed} Plays, starting at {location}. Canonical removal also removes {notes} commentaries and {responses} response links. Removed Plays are listed below; the retained prefix remains in accepted history.
recovery.removal_final: Apply permanently removes this suffix from the current recording. There is no persistent Undo/Redo or automatic restoration.
recovery.removed_annotations: Inspect commentary and response links to remove
recovery.replacement: Replace {old} with {new}; retain all {count} following Plays. The entire candidate is rebuilt and validated.
recovery.saved: Correction saved. Continue recording this Game; a previously rejected Card has not been resubmitted.
recovery.unchanged: Same Card: no recording change, revision increment, file write, or Report invalidation.
recovery.warning: Recording warning: later accepted evidence proves an earlier conflict. This partial recording can still be continued or corrected; complete validation remains required.
recovery.witness.known: Witness from the explicitly known playable hand: {card}.
recovery.witness.proposed: Witness from proposed input, not accepted history: {card}.
related.heading: Related areas
result.limit.budget: The analysis is bounded by its selected method, samples, and public budget.
result.limit.claim: Claim adjudication is limited to the bounded party-wide all-remaining-Tricks form.
result.limit.coaching: Replay Coaching is bounded to retained review evidence and makes no causal claim.
result.limit.cutoff: Only information available at the analysis cutoff is used.
result.limit.global: Decision reviews remain bounded to their retained public evidence and do not establish one globally optimal game policy.
result.limit.historical_cutoff: Historical comparisons use only information available at each Decision cutoff.
result.limit.information_coaching: Information-set Coaching uses complete Candidate evidence without fallback.
result.limit.observed: The actual Card is observed retrospective evidence, not ground truth.
result.limit.policy: Opponent behavior follows the fixed public policy settings used for this analysis.
result.limit.probability: Compatible-world counts and samples are evidence coverage, not calibrated probability.
result.limit.search: Search is not a perfect-play claim.
result.limit.tactical: Tactical motifs are structural observations, not quality, intent, signaling, communication, or causal claims.
result.no_candidates: No Candidate comparison is available for this Result.
